# no-icon-picker

<!-- AUTOGENERATED:BEGIN — do not edit; regenerated by `./equin build` -->

## Plugin reference

- Description: The place icons of a host without a model: provides the PlaceIconPicker host service as nothing to pick with — there is no Claude CLI to ask, so a new place keeps drawing its main tag's icon, the same pin the desktop draws before its pick lands (the browser composition). Never booted by the desktop.
- Excluded: yes
- Server:
  - Contributes: `host-service:places.icon-picker` "places.icon-picker"
  - Uses: `apps/places/places-core.PlaceIconPicker`
